extracted.name: Chicken Divan
extracted.description: This easy chicken Divan with curry is a faster version of the classic recipe, using canned ingredients, leftovers, and condensed soup to speed up the prep.
ingredient_lines: 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 3-quart casserole dish.
Mix condensed soup, mayonnaise, melted butter, lemon juice, and curry powder together in a bowl.
Arrange broccoli over the bottom of the prepared casserole dish. Top with chicken, then mushrooms, and finally water chestnuts. Pour soup mixture over top, then sprinkle with Cheddar.
Bake in the preheated oven until casserole is bubbly and cheese is golden brown, 30 to 45 minutes.
